content.full_text: On The Laura Flanders Show on GRITtv: Author/activist Arundhati Roy on the Annihilation of Caste, B.R. Ambedkar and the Western myth of Mahatma Gandhi. And Glenn Greenwald addresses diversity concerns about his new media venture The Intercept.com. See the full episode on Monday on GRITtv.org, TeleSur English and beyond.
